name: DualSense
description: The relative proximity of the 24 GHz ISM band and the 5G FR2 band offers promising opportunities for Integrated Sensing and Communication (ISAC) operations leveraging directional transmission/reception capabilities of phased arrays. To explore this opportunity, we present DualSense, a testbed that comprises (a) state-of-the art programmable dual-polarized phased array modules that cover both the 24 GHz ISM band and the 24.25–26 GHz portion of the 5G FR2 band, (b) a wide band software-defined radio (SDR), and (c) FPGA and PC for computation and orchestration.
